document.name: BAFA Jamaica Singing Classes
document.shortDescription: Friday singing classes in Jamaica at BAFA’s Queens location, with after-school and evening sessions.
document.longDescription:
The official BAFA class schedules page lists its Queens location in Jamaica at 86-44 Edgerton Boulevard with booking email bafa.inc.usa@gmail.com and phone (347) 387-7897. The current Queens Friday schedule includes two singing classes, from 5:00 PM to 6:30 PM and from 6:30 PM to 7:30 PM.

Because the published listing is clearly tied to Friday afternoon and evening singing instruction at the Jamaica location, this entry uses weekday, afternoon, after-school, and evening tags. BAFA describes its mission as building a diverse cultural community through performing arts training and education.

Sources: https://www.bafausa.org/class-schedules https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/61eb966cc6417f1e8dd30e30/1642830400111-JC2YHQ3PUTNM75QG836U/A43348E1-2404-4277-80B4-D9C526D0086D_1_105_c.jpeg
